# Cases genuine RISC OS 5 answers for lib/obey's replay: the kinds and
# fields `cargo xtask riscos --reference` documents. Cases run in order on
# one machine, so each sees the variables those before it left.

# GSInit: spaces skipped, the first byte unexpanded, an empty string.
gstrans "   ab" "0" "16"
gsread "   ab" "0"
gsread "\x09x" "0"
gsread "\x22ab\x22" "0"
gsread "" "0"
gsread "  " "0"

# Quotes.
gstrans "ab\x22c" "0" "16"
gstrans "\x22a\x22\x22b\x22" "0" "16"
gstrans "\x22a\x22  b" "0" "16"
gsread "\x22a\x22  b" "0"
gstrans "\x22a\x22" "&80000000" "16"
gstrans "\x22open" "0" "16"
gstrans "\x22a b\x22 c" "&20000000" "16"

# Control characters inside a string.
gstrans "a\x09b" "0" "16"
gstrans "a\x01b" "0" "16"
gstrans "a\x7Fb" "0" "16"
gstrans "a\x0Ab" "0" "16"
gstrans "a\x00b" "0" "16"

# A space ends the string only outside quotes and expansions.
setvar "ZqS" "a b" "3" "4"
setvar "ZqM" "c d" "3" "2"
gstrans "<ZqS>x" "&20000000" "16"
gstrans "<ZqM>x" "&20000000" "16"
gstrans "a b" "&20000000" "16"
gstrans "ab cd" "&20000000" "16"

# A string variable delivered as it is, a number in decimal, a macro read inline.
setvar "ZqR" "a\x0D<x>|M" "7" "4"
gstrans "<ZqR>!" "0" "32"
setvar "ZqN" "\xD6\xFF\xFF\xFF" "4" "1"
gstrans "<ZqN>" "0" "16"
setvar "ZqM2" "  \x22x\x22" "5" "2"
gstrans "[<ZqM2>]" "0" "32"
readvar "ZqM2" "64" "3"
setvar "ZqQ" "a\x22b" "3" "2"
gstrans "\x22<ZqQ>\x22" "0" "32"
setvar "ZqP" "a|" "2" "2"
gstrans "<ZqP>M" "0" "8"

# Every escape of a printable byte but the top-bit marker, and of a top-bit byte,
# scattered so that no answer is a run of consecutive bytes.
gstrans "| |E|j|0|U|z|@|e|+|P|u|;|`|&|K|p|6|[|F|k|1|V|{|A|f|,|Q|v|<|a|'|L|q|7|\x5C|\x22|G|l|2|W|||B|g|-|R|w|=|b|(|M|r|8|]|#|H|m|3|X|}|C|h|.|S|x|>|c|)|N|s|9|^|$|I|n|4|Y|~|D|i|/|T|y|?|d|*|O|t|:|_|%|J|o|5|Z" "0" "256"
gstrans "|\x7F" "0" "4"
gstrans "|\x80|\xA5|\xCA|\xEF|\x94|\xB9|\xDE|\x83|\xA8|\xCD|\xF2|\x97|\xBC|\xE1|\x86|\xAB|\xD0|\xF5|\x9A|\xBF|\xE4|\x89|\xAE|\xD3|\xF8|\x9D|\xC2|\xE7|\x8C|\xB1|\xD6|\xFB|\xA0|\xC5|\xEA|\x8F|\xB4|\xD9|\xFE|\xA3|\xC8|\xED|\x92|\xB7|\xDC|\x81|\xA6|\xCB|\xF0|\x95|\xBA|\xDF|\x84|\xA9|\xCE|\xF3|\x98|\xBD|\xE2|\x87|\xAC|\xD1|\xF6|\x9B|\xC0|\xE5|\x8A|\xAF|\xD4|\xF9|\x9E|\xC3|\xE8|\x8D|\xB2|\xD7|\xFC|\xA1|\xC6|\xEB|\x90|\xB5|\xDA|\xFF|\xA4|\xC9|\xEE|\x93|\xB8|\xDD|\x82|\xA7|\xCC|\xF1|\x96|\xBB|\xE0|\x85|\xAA|\xCF|\xF4|\x99|\xBE|\xE3|\x88|\xAD|\xD2|\xF7|\x9C|\xC1|\xE6|\x8B|\xB0|\xD5|\xFA|\x9F|\xC4|\xE9|\x8E|\xB3|\xD8|\xFD|\xA2|\xC7|\xEC|\x91|\xB6|\xDB" "0" "256"
gstrans "ab|" "0" "8"
gstrans "|\x01" "0" "4"
gstrans "|\x0D" "0" "4"

# The top-bit marker.
gstrans "|!|!A" "0" "4"
gstrans "|!<65>" "0" "4"
setvar "ZqName" "Fred" "4" "4"
gstrans "|!<ZqName>" "0" "8"
gstrans "|!<ZqNoSuch>x" "0" "4"
gstrans "|!" "0" "4"
gstrans "a|!" "0" "4"
gstrans "|!|@" "0" "4"
gstrans "|!|?" "0" "4"
gstrans "|!\x01" "0" "4"
gstrans "|!\x22a\x22" "0" "4"
gsread "|!<321>" "0"

# Character codes.
gstrans "<&41><2_1000010><16_43>" "0" "8"
gstrans "<321>" "0" "4"
gsread "<321>" "0"
gsread "<4294967295>" "0"
gstrans "[<65a>]" "0" "8"
gstrans "[<4294967296>]" "0" "16"
gstrans "a<0>b" "0" "8"
gstrans "< 65>" "0" "8"
gstrans "<65 >" "0" "8"

# What a `<` begins.
gstrans "<> < x> <a b> <open" "0" "32"
gstrans "<<ZqName>>" "0" "16"
gstrans "<xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx>!" "0" "300"
gstrans "<xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx>!" "0" "300"
gstrans "<xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx>!" "0" "300"
gstrans "<ZqName" "0" "16"
gstrans "<Zq\x01Name>" "0" "16"

# Wildcard references, an unset reference.
setvar "ZqWb" "2" "1" "4"
setvar "ZqWa" "1" "1" "4"
gstrans "<ZqW*>" "0" "8"
gstrans "<ZqW#>" "0" "8"
gstrans "<ZqW*b>" "0" "8"
gstrans "[<ZqNoSuch>]" "0" "8"

# The buffer: an exact fit, no room, a space that ends the string.
gstrans "Fred" "0" "4"
gstrans "Fred" "0" "5"
gstrans "" "0" "0"
gstrans "" "0" "1"
gstrans "a" "0" "1"
gstrans "ab|" "0" "8"
gsread "ab c" "&20000000"
gsread "\x22ab\x22  x" "0"
gsread "a|Mb" "0"
gsread "a<ZqName>b" "0"
gsread "|!<ZqName>" "0"
cli "Unset Zq*"

# Expressions: priority and association.
evaluate "1+2*3" "256"
evaluate "10-4-3" "256"
evaluate "8/4/2" "256"
evaluate "7 MOD 4*2" "256"
evaluate "1 << 1+1" "256"
evaluate "4=1 << 2" "256"
evaluate "3 > 2 > 1" "256"
evaluate "1 AND 3=3" "256"
evaluate "3 OR 4 AND 1" "256"
evaluate "1 OR 3 EOR 1" "256"
evaluate "-8 >>> 1" "256"
evaluate "NOT 1+1" "256"
evaluate "NOT 0" "256"
evaluate "LEN \x22ab\x22+\x22cd\x22" "256"
evaluate "STR 1+2" "256"
evaluate "VAL \x221\x22+\x222\x22" "256"
evaluate "\x22hello\x22 LEFT 2 LEFT 1" "256"
evaluate "STR -12 LEFT 2" "256"
evaluate "127 * 23 >> 2" "256"
evaluate "1+7" "256"
evaluate "1234 LEFT 2" "256"
evaluate "(\x22myfile/doc\x22 RIGHT 4) LEFT 1 = \x22/\x22" "256"
evaluate "2 < 3 = -1" "256"
evaluate "-1 = 2 < 3" "256"
evaluate "1 << 2 << 3" "256"
evaluate "64 >> 2 >> 1" "256"
evaluate "5 - -3" "256"
evaluate "- -3" "256"
evaluate "2*3 MOD 4" "256"
evaluate "7 MOD 4 MOD 2" "256"
evaluate "1 EOR 3 OR 4" "256"
evaluate "6 AND 3 OR 8" "256"
evaluate "NOT 0 AND 1" "256"
evaluate "1 = 1 AND 2 = 2" "256"
evaluate "\x22a\x22 + \x22b\x22 = \x22ab\x22" "256"
evaluate "LEN \x22abc\x22 * 2" "256"
evaluate "-LEN \x22abc\x22" "256"
evaluate "VAL \x222\x22 * 3" "256"
evaluate "\x22x\x22 + STR 5" "256"
evaluate "(1+2)*3" "256"
evaluate "((4))" "256"
evaluate "-(2+3)" "256"
setvar "ZqWord" "\xD2\x04\x00\x00" "4" "1"
evaluate "ZqWord LEFT 2+1" "256"
evaluate "ZqWord RIGHT 2" "256"

evaluate "ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (ZqS RIGHT (0)))))))))))))))" "2048"

# Each type set and read back.

setvar "ZqM5" "ab\x0Acd" "5" "2"

readvar "ZqE" "64" "3"

readvar "ZqE2" "64" "0"
setvar "ZqE3" "\x22ab\x22 + \x22cd\x22" "11" "3"
readvar "ZqE3" "64" "0"

readvar "ZqE4" "64" "0"

setvar "ZqLit" "abc" "3" "4"

readvar "ZqNoSuch" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqNoSuch" "-1" "0"
setvar "ZqT7" "x" "1" "7"
setvar "ZqBig" "" "1000" "4"
setvar "ZqHuge" "<ZqBig><ZqBig><ZqBig><ZqBig><ZqBig>" "35" "0"
readvar "ZqHuge" "8" "0"
setvar "ZqHuge2" "<ZqBig><ZqBig>" "14" "0"
readvar "ZqHuge2" "8" "0"
cli "Unset Zq*"

# Command lines read for their variables: leading stars, comments, Set's value.
cli " * *Set ZqA5 1"
readvar "ZqA5" "64" "0"
cli " *| Set ZqA6 2"
readvar "ZqA6" "64" "0"
cli "Set ZqA10   x  "
readvar "ZqA10" "64" "0"
cli "set ZqA11 lower"
readvar "ZqA11" "64" "0"
cli "SETMACRO ZqA12 <ZqA11>!"
readvar "ZqA12" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqA12" "64" "3"
cli "Set ZqA13 \x22quoted value\x22 tail"
readvar "ZqA13" "64" "0"
cli "Set ZqOnly"
readvar "ZqOnly" "64" "0"
cli "Set ZqA14 a|"
readvar "ZqA14" "64" "0"
cli "Set \x22ZqA15\x22 x"
readvar "\x22ZqA15\x22" "64" "0"
cli "Unset \x22ZqA15\x22"
readvar "\x22ZqA15\x22" "64" "0"
setvar "ZqU1" "1" "1" "4"
setvar "ZqU2" "2" "1" "4"
cli "Unset ZqU1 ZqU2"
readvar "ZqU1" "64" "0"
cli "Unset \x22ZqU1 ZqU2\x22"
readvar "ZqU1" "64" "0"
cli "Unset"
cli "IconSprites"
cli "IconSprites ZqNoSuchFile extra"
cli "IconSprites ZqNoSuchFile extra more"
obey "IconSprites\x0ASet ZqIc1 1\x0A" ""
readvar "ZqIc1" "64" "0"
setvar "ZqU3" "3" "1" "4"
setvar "ZqU4" "4" "1" "4"
cli "Unset ZqU*"
readvar "ZqU3" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqU4" "64" "0"
cli "%Set ZqAl2 1"
readvar "ZqAl2" "64" "0"
cli "Set ZqLn1 "
readvar "ZqLn1" "4" "0"
cli "Set ZqLn2 "
readvar "ZqLn2" "4" "0"
cli "Set ZqLn3 "
readvar "ZqLn3" "4" "0"

# If: where Then and Else are found, what the condition may be.
cli "If 1 Then Set ZqI1 y"
readvar "ZqI1" "64" "0"
cli "If 0 Then Set ZqI2 y"
readvar "ZqI2" "64" "0"
cli "If 1 then Set ZqI3 y"
readvar "ZqI3" "64" "0"
cli "If 1 THEN Set ZqI4 y"
readvar "ZqI4" "64" "0"
cli "If 1 Thenx Set ZqI5 y"
readvar "ZqI5" "64" "0"
cli "If 1"
cli "If \x22s\x22 Then Set ZqI6 y"
readvar "ZqI6" "64" "0"
cli "If \x22a Then b\x22=\x22\x22 Then Set ZqI7 y"
readvar "ZqI7" "64" "0"
cli "If 1 Then Set ZqI8 a Else"
readvar "ZqI8" "64" "0"
cli "If 1 Then Set ZqI9 \x22x Else y\x22 Else Set ZqI10 z"
readvar "ZqI9" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqI10" "64" "0"
cli "If 0 Then Set ZqI11 a Else Set ZqI12 b"
readvar "ZqI11" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqI12" "64" "0"
cli "If 0 Then Set ZqI13 a ELSE Set ZqI14 b"
readvar "ZqI14" "64" "0"
cli "If 2-2 Then Set ZqI15 a Else If 1 Then Set ZqI16 b"
readvar "ZqI16" "64" "0"
cli "If 1Then Set ZqI17 a"
readvar "ZqI17" "64" "0"
cli "If 1 Then  Set ZqI18 a"
readvar "ZqI18" "64" "0"
cli "If 1+ Then Set ZqI19 a"
readvar "ZqI19" "64" "0"
# A condition whose references expand past the line is not asked: RISC OS 5.30
# does not return from `If <ZqL>=1 Then` with ZqL 1100 bytes long.
setvar "ZqBadM" "a|" "2" "2"
cli "If <ZqBadM>=1 Then Set ZqI22 a"
readvar "ZqI22" "64" "0"
cli "If \x22<ZqBadM>\x22=\x22\x22 Then Set ZqI23 a"
readvar "ZqI23" "64" "0"
cli "If 1/0 Then Set ZqI24 a"
readvar "ZqI24" "64" "0"
cli "If 1\x01 Then Set ZqI25 a"
readvar "ZqI25" "64" "0"
evaluate "\x22\x01\x22" "256"
cli "If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then If 1 Then Set ZqI21 deep"
readvar "ZqI21" "64" "0"

# Obey files: their lines, their parameters, a failing line.
obey "Set ZqA2 1\x0DSet ZqB2 2\x0A" ""
readvar "ZqA2" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqB2" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqA3 1\x0ASet ZqB3 |\x0ASet ZqC3 3\x0A" ""
readvar "ZqA3" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqC3" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqP4 [%1]\x0A" "a b c"
readvar "ZqP4" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqP5 [%0][%*1]\x0A" "a \x22b c\x22 d"
readvar "ZqP5" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqD <Obey$Dir>\x0A" ""
readvar "ZqD" "64" "0"
obey "| comment\x0A\x0ASet ZqE5 5\x0D\x0ASet ZqE6 6" ""
readvar "ZqE5" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqE6" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqF1 \x0ASet ZqG1 1\x0A" ""

readvar "ZqG1" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqF2 \x0ASet ZqG2 1\x0A" ""
readvar "ZqF2" "4" "0"
readvar "ZqG2" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqF3 \x0ASet ZqG3 1\x0A" ""
readvar "ZqF3" "4" "0"
readvar "ZqG3" "64" "0"
obey "Set ZqN1 1\x00Set ZqN2 2\x0ASet ZqN3 3\x0A" ""

readvar "ZqN2" "64" "0"
readvar "ZqN3" "64" "0"

obey "Set ZqJ1 1\x0AUnset ZqJ1 ZqJ2\x0ASet ZqJ3 3\x0A" ""
readvar "ZqJ3" "64" "0"
cli "Unset Zq*"

# The bytes that end a command's name, and a name; but for `.`, which marks an
# abbreviation, never followed by a reading that runs nothing.
sweep "Set" "SwQ 1" "32" "45" "*SwQ"
sweep "Set" "SwQ 1" "47" "255" "*SwQ"
sweep "Set ZqSw" " 1" "32" "255" "ZqSw*"
sweep "Set" "SwQ\x22 1" "32" "45" "*SwQ*"
sweep "Set" "SwQ\x22 1" "47" "255" "*SwQ*"
